description: This script manages advanced security features for a device, including starting/stopping agents, loading kernel modules, managing ipsets, and handling configuration and restart procedures for security components like fingerprinting, parental control, privacy protection, and more.

methods.name: advsec_is_agent_installed
methods.description: Checks if the security agent is installed by verifying the presence of its launch binary.

methods.name: advsec_start_agent
methods.description: Starts the security agent if it is not already running.

methods.name: advsec_wait_for_agent
methods.description: Waits for the agent to become active, with a timeout and retries.

methods.name: advsec_agent_start_fp
methods.description: Enables fingerprinting feature in the agent.

methods.name: advsec_module_load
methods.description: Loads necessary kernel modules and initializes nfqueue.

methods.name: advsec_module_unload
methods.description: Unloads kernel modules and cleans up.

methods.name: advsec_kernel_module_load
methods.description: Loads a specific kernel module if present.

methods.name: advsec_kernel_module_unload
methods.description: Unloads a specific kernel module if loaded.

methods.name: advsec_initialize_nfq_ct
methods.description: Initializes connection tracking for nfqueue if applicable.

methods.name: advsec_agent_create_ipsets
methods.description: Creates ipset lists for security features.

methods.name: advsec_agent_restart_needed
methods.description: Checks if agent restart is needed based on network state.

methods.name: advsec_is_alive
methods.description: Checks if the agent process is running.

methods.name: advsec_restart_agent
methods.description: Performs a full restart of the agent, reinitializing modules and features.

methods.name: advsec_get_agent_group_name
methods.description: Retrieves the system username of the agent process.

methods.name: advsec_agent_loglevel
methods.description: Sets the log level of the agent.

methods.name: advsec_agent_get_safebro_config
methods.description: Fetches safebro configuration from the agent.

methods.name: wait_for_lanip
methods.description: Waits until LAN IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are assigned.
